chars.SISTER: SISTER: a young woman wearing a mustard-yellow oversized hoodie, light-blue ripped jeans and big gold hoop earrings.
chars.BRO: BRO: a teenage boy wearing a forest-green tracksuit jacket with two white stripes on the sleeves and black joggers.
chars.COUSIN: COUSIN: a young woman wearing a hot-pink cropped puffer jacket, black leggings, white chunky sneakers and big sunglasses pushed up on her head.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small modest Moroccan kitchen at night. SISTER, seen head-to-waist from the doorway, is secretly pushing a thick white envelope stuffed with banknotes into BRO's hands, glancing nervously over her shoulder toward the door. BRO looks surprised. Tense, secretive mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: A long quiet street of a small Moroccan town (Kenitra) in the evening, old apartment buildings and a closed shop. COUSIN walks beside BRO and leans toward him, whispering with a sly smirk and one hand raised near her mouth. BRO listens, eyebrows raised. Head-to-waist framing, faces clearly visible.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Same evening Moroccan street. COUSIN bursts out laughing mockingly, pointing at BRO with one hand and holding her belly with the other. BRO stares at her confused and a bit hurt. Comic awkward mood.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Same evening Moroccan street. COUSIN suddenly stops laughing, presses her lips shut and looks away to the side, pretending to check her phone, clearly hiding something. BRO stands next to her, staring at her suspiciously with narrowed eyes. Awkward silence.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Middle of the same evening Moroccan street under a street lamp. BRO has stopped and stands firmly in front of COUSIN, arms crossed, blocking her way. COUSIN, cornered, leans in and starts to whisper a big secret, eyes wide, one hand cupped by her mouth. Suspenseful mood.
